judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across tool rounds while handling missing per-round usage without NaN or undefined poisoning. It satisfies all acceptance criteria, including taking the extra step of introducing a `TurnUsage` type alias (in addition to renaming the parameter to `turnUsage`) to satisfy the requirement that 'The type of what the hook receives makes the answer unambiguous'. Compared to the reference, which added a private helper in `chatOrchestrator.ts` and tests in `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate placed `addUsage` in `orchestratorHelpers.ts` and created two new test files (`chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` and `turnUsage.test.ts`). The candidate also placed the new spec items under the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of moving them to the main spec section, and left a `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the diff.
